obex_enabled.description: Enable the OBEX server to accept connections.

obex_root_path.description: Absolute path to the root directory where OBEX file transfers are stored.

obex_user.description: System user account under which the OBEX daemon process runs.

obex_group.description: System group for the OBEX daemon process.

obex_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous OBEX connections allowed.

obex_auth_enabled.description: Require authentication before allowing file transfers.

obex_encrypt_enabled.description: Require encryption for all OBEX sessions (requires compatible devices).

obex_auto_accept.description: Automatically accept incoming OBEX file transfer requests without prompting.

obex_allowed_peers.description: List of trusted Bluetooth device addresses (MAC addresses) allowed to connect. Leave empty to allow all (not recommended).

items.description: Bluetooth MAC address in uppercase with colons (e.g., 'AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF').

obex_denied_peers.description: List of Bluetooth device addresses explicitly denied from connecting.

items.description: Bluetooth MAC address in uppercase with colons (e.g., 'AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF').

obex_log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0=errors only, 1=warnings + errors, 2=info + warnings, 3=debug (very verbose).

obex_log_stderr.description: Send logs to standard error instead of syslog (useful for containers or debugging).

obex_log_file.description: Optional absolute path to a dedicated log file. If omitted, syslog is used.
